ALTCHA widget (vendored, not modified)

package   : altcha (npm) 2.3.0, MIT licence (see LICENSE)
source    : https://registry.npmjs.org/altcha/-/altcha-2.3.0.tgz  (package/dist/altcha.umd.cjs)
tarball   : npm integrity sha512-vl8I0dQvSQB7/Mx09XuWZ1+LdSP7vEda6OLbg9kUQ2ZO2LT7MzgUyLK7Iips+GAV6c0ntVcS1XWOqhEPpwbDhQ==
file      : altcha.min.js = dist/altcha.umd.cjs (minified UMD, registers <altcha-widget>)
sha256    : 0f557a9f535a15acbe0fc7abb4fe896502a6d4c27de1c4145cfa001d0d2be099

Why 2.3.0: it speaks the PoW v1 protocol (`challengejson` with algorithm / challenge /
maxNumber / salt / signature) that the pinned Python library altcha==2.3.0 serves through
create_challenge_v1 / verify_solution_v1. Widget 3.x moves to PoW v2 and would need the
unprefixed (v2) server API and a different challenge shape.

Needs a secure context (HTTPS or localhost: crypto.subtle). It starts its solver in a
Worker from a data: URL, so a future Content-Security-Policy must allow `worker-src data:`.

To update: download the new tarball, replace altcha.min.js, update this file and the
Python pin together, run tests/test_captcha.py.
